Sheepskins

Preserved for a new chapter

Every hide is unique — not only in colour, shape, or fleece, but in the story it carries. You can read that story in the small marks life has left behind. Tanned by hand, with time, attention, and what nature provides — a hide to live on, to work with, or simply to admire.

Interested in one of my hand-tanned hides? Send me a message and we'll look together at what's available at the moment; the selection changes all the time.

I choose to brush the fleece no more than necessary, so its natural character is preserved. I also leave the hide as close to its natural shape as possible, so its origin stays visible. Sometimes the fleece still carries a small trace of the outdoors: a blade of grass, a seed, or something else that recalls a life outside.

How the fleece develops from there, I gladly leave to you. You can brush it further at home to the look you like. Prefer a classic sheepskin shape? I'm happy to trim the hide to order.

Average price: € 150

The price varies with the size, wool quality, and character of the hide.
